newsitem.title: USA: Mueller says optimistic for rest of 1997.
newsitem.headline: Mueller says optimistic for rest of 1997.

text.p: Mueller Industries Inc said on Thursday it is optimistic that the company will continue to perform strongly for the next three quarters because of high consumer confidence and low inflation.

"Our manufacturing operations continue to show the benefits of our major capital improvment programs. We remain optimistic about our business for the balance of 1997," said Harvey Karp, the company's chairman.

Citing long-term morgage rates near eight percent, he added, "Consumer confidence remains high and inflation is at a low level. We believe these factors will translate into a sound economic scenario going forward."

Mueller reported a 19 percent increase in net income for the first quarter, compared with the same quarter last year. Earnings for the first quarter were 80 cents per share, compared to 69 cents per share for the same period in 1996.
Mueller is a multinational fabricator of copper tube, brass and copper rods and other tubular products.
